package sandbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) CreateVerificationWorkspace(ctx context.Context, profile domain.RuntimeProfileRef, fixture domain.WorkspaceFixture, ttl time.Duration) (domain.VerificationWorkspace, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"schema": "sandbox-verification-workspace-request.v1", "runtime_profile_ref": profile, "ttl_seconds": int(ttl.Seconds()), "files": fixture.Files})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/verification-workspaces", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, err
	}
	client.headers(request)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, fmt.Errorf("sandbox verification workspace returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: 64<<10 + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var result struct {
		Schema    string    `json:"schema"`
		ID        string    `json:"id"`
		RootPath  string    `json:"root_path"`
		ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 || result.Schema != "sandbox-verification-workspace.v1" || result.ID == "" || result.RootPath != "/workspaces/"+result.ID || !result.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now().UTC()) {
		return domain.VerificationWorkspace{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return domain.VerificationWorkspace{ID: result.ID, RootPath: result.RootPath}, nil
}
func (client Client) DeleteVerificationWorkspace(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodDelete, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/verification-workspaces/"+url.PathEscape(id), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	client.headers(request)
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusNoContent && response.StatusCode != http.StatusNotFound {
		return fmt.Errorf("sandbox verification workspace delete returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
	}
	return nil
}
func (client Client) headers(request *http.Request) {
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
}
func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second}
}

var _ domain.VerificationWorkspaceClient = Client{}
